          Difficile : cibles multiples activées par défaut, intervalles resserrés, temporisations plus courtes.<br>

    <!-- ORDRES DE MOUVEMENT -->
    <div class="block" data-block="orders">
      <div class="block-head" onclick="toggleBlock('orders')">
        <div class="block-head-left">
          <div class="toggle" id="tg-orders" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); toggleModule('orders')"></div>
          <div>
            <div class="block-title">Ordres de mouvement</div>
            <div class="block-desc">Postures, immobilisation et déplacements</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="chev">▸</div>
      </div>
      <div class="block-body">
        <div class="chip-row" id="orderChips">
          <span class="chip on" data-order="couche">Couché</span>
          <span class="chip on" data-order="genoux">À genoux</span>
          <span class="chip on" data-order="accroupi">Accroupi</span>
          <span class="chip on" data-order="fige">Ne pas bouger</span>
          <span class="chip on" data-order="avancer">Avancer</span>
          <span class="chip on" data-order="reculer">Reculer</span>
          <span class="chip on" data-order="bouger">Bouger / changer de position</span>
          <span class="chip on" data-order="abri">Homme à terre : à l'abri</span>
          <span class="chip on" data-order="couverture">Je couvre</span>
        </div>
        <div class="subnote">
          Couché / à genoux / accroupi restent compatibles avec une annonce de couleur simultanée.<br>
          « Ne pas bouger » bloque les annonces de couleur pendant sa durée (son continu discret en fond marquant début/fin) — un tir peut survenir pendant ce temps, à vous de juger si vous étiez à couvert.<br>
          Avancer / reculer / bouger bloquent aussi les annonces de couleur (mais pas les tirs) et utilisent une plage de temps dédiée, plus longue, pour laisser le temps physique de se déplacer.<br>
          « Homme à terre, mettez-le à l'abri » est un déplacement : mêmes règles qu'avancer / reculer (couleurs bloquées, tirs actifs, plage de temps d'exécution).<br>
          « Je couvre » est l'inverse de « Ne pas bouger » : les sons de tir sont coupés pendant sa durée (même plage que les postures), les annonces de couleur continuent normalement.
        </div>
        <div class="field-row">
          <div class="field-label">Temporisation aléatoire (postures)</div>
          <div class="toggle on" id="tg-randomHold" onclick="toggleFlag('randomHold')"></div>

          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="field-row">
          <div><div class="field-label">Durée d'exécution (avancer / reculer / bouger)</div><div class="field-help">secondes, min – max, 5 s minimum recommandé</div></div>
          <div class="time-input">
            <input type="number" id="moveMin" value="5" min="1" max="60"> – <input type="number" id="moveMax" value="10" min="1" max="60">

const PREP_LOCKED_OFF = ['shots','orders','fatigue','decoys','reload','injuries','switch','extraction'];

const state = {
  modules: { colors:true, shots:true, orders:false, fatigue:false, decoys:false, multi:false, reload:false, ambiance:false, injuries:false, switch:false, extraction:false },
  flags: { spatial:false, randomHold:true, extrCasualty:true },
  prepPhysique: false,
  colorsSelected: new Set(["Rouge","Bleu","Vert","Jaune"]),
  shotCfg: defaultShotCfg(),
  ordersSelected: new Set(["couche","genoux","accroupi","fige","avancer","reculer","bouger","abri","couverture"]),
  ambianceSelected: new Set(["circulation","animaux"]),
  injuriesSelected: new Set(INJURY_KEYS),
  switchSelected: new Set(SWITCH_KEYS),
  prepExercisesSelected: new Set(["pompes","squats","tractions"]),
  timeMode: "continu",
  extrMode: "unique",
  chronoMinutes: 5,
  difficulty: "moyen",
};

/* ---------- chip builders (couleurs / ambiance / exercices) ---------- */
function buildChips(containerId, items, selectedSet, labelMap, dataAttr){
  const wrap = document.getElementById(containerId);
  items.forEach(key=>{
    const el = document.createElement('span');
    el.className = 'chip' + (selectedSet.has(key) ? ' on' : '');
    el.dataset[dataAttr] = key;
    el.textContent = labelMap ? labelMap[key] : key;
    el.onclick = ()=>{
      el.classList.toggle('on');
      if(el.classList.contains('on')) selectedSet.add(key); else selectedSet.delete(key);
    };
    wrap.appendChild(el);
  });
}
buildChips('colorChips', ALL_COLORS, state.colorsSelected, null, 'color');
renderAmbianceChips();
buildChips('prepChips', PREP_EXERCISES, state.prepExercisesSelected, PREP_LABELS, 'ex');
buildChips('injuryChips', INJURY_KEYS, state.injuriesSelected, INJURY_LABELS, 'inj');
(function(){
  const wrap = document.getElementById('switchChips');
  SWITCH_KEYS.forEach(k=>{
    const el = document.createElement('span');
    el.className = 'chip wsw' + (state.switchSelected.has(k) ? ' on' : '');
    el.dataset.sw = k;
    el.innerHTML = SWITCH_SVG[k] + '<span>' + SWITCH_LABELS[k] + '</span>';
    el.onclick = ()=>{
      el.classList.toggle('on');
      if(el.classList.contains('on')) state.switchSelected.add(k); else state.switchSelected.delete(k);
    };
    wrap.appendChild(el);
  });
})();

document.querySelectorAll('#orderChips .chip').forEach(el=>{
  el.onclick = ()=>{
    el.classList.toggle('on');
    const k = el.dataset.order;
    if(el.classList.contains('on')) state.ordersSelected.add(k); else state.ordersSelected.delete(k);
  };
});

function toggleAllChips(containerId, selectedSet){
  const wrap = document.getElementById(containerId);
  const chips = wrap.querySelectorAll('.chip');
  const allOn = Array.from(chips).every(c=>c.classList.contains('on'));
  chips.forEach(c=>{
    if(allOn) c.classList.remove('on'); else c.classList.add('on');
    const key = c.dataset.color || c.dataset.amb || c.dataset.ex || c.dataset.inj || c.dataset.sw;
    if(key){ if(!allOn) selectedSet.add(key); else selectedSet.delete(key); }
  });
}

function toggleBlock(name){
  document.querySelector(`.block[data-block="${name}"]`).classList.toggle('open');
}
function setModuleState(name, val){
  state.modules[name] = val;
  const tg = document.getElementById('tg-'+name); if(tg) tg.classList.toggle('on', val);
  const blk = document.querySelector(`.block[data-block="${name}"]`); if(blk) blk.classList.toggle('active', val);
}
function toggleModule(name){
  if(state.prepPhysique && (PREP_LOCKED_OFF.includes(name) || name==='colors')) return; // verrouillé pendant la préparation physique
  setModuleState(name, !state.modules[name]);
}
function toggleFlag(name){
  state.flags[name] = !state.flags[name];
  document.getElementById('tg-'+name).classList.toggle('on', state.flags[name]);
}
function syncRangeLabel(id){
  document.getElementById(id+'Val').textContent = document.getElementById(id).value + '%';
}

function togglePrepPhysique(){
  state.prepPhysique = !state.prepPhysique;
  document.getElementById('tg-prep').classList.toggle('on', state.prepPhysique);
  document.querySelector('.block[data-block="prep"]').classList.toggle('active', state.prepPhysique);
  if(state.prepPhysique){
    PREP_LOCKED_OFF.forEach(m=> setModuleState(m, false));
    setModuleState('colors', true);
  }
  updateLockVisuals();
}
function updateLockVisuals(){
  PREP_LOCKED_OFF.forEach(m=>{
    const blk = document.querySelector(`.block[data-block="${m}"]`);
    if(blk) blk.classList.toggle('locked', state.prepPhysique);
  });
  const colorToggle = document.getElementById('tg-colors');
  if(colorToggle) colorToggle.classList.toggle('locked', state.prepPhysique);
  document.getElementById('sessExercise').classList.toggle('show', false);
}

function setDifficulty(d){
  state.difficulty = d;
  document.querySelectorAll('#difficultySeg > div').forEach(el=>el.classList.toggle('on', el.dataset.diff===d));
  const labels = {facile:'Facile', moyen:'Moyen', difficile:'Difficile'};
  document.getElementById('difficultyLabel').textContent = labels[d];
  applyDifficultyDefaults(d);
}
function applyDifficultyDefaults(d){
  if(state.prepPhysique) return; // la préparation physique garde ses propres réglages
  if(d==='facile'){
    setModuleState('decoys', false);
    setModuleState('multi', false);
    setModuleState('fatigue', false);
  } else if(d==='moyen'){
    setModuleState('fatigue', true);
    setModuleState('decoys', true);
    setModuleState('multi', false);
  } else if(d==='difficile'){
    setModuleState('fatigue', true);
    setModuleState('decoys', true);
    setModuleState('multi', true);
  }
}
// >1 = pauses plus longues (facile) · <1 = pauses plus courtes, plus d'événements (difficile)
function difficultyMult(){
  return state.difficulty==='facile' ? 1.4 : state.difficulty==='difficile' ? 0.6 : 1.0;
}
function difficultyDecoyMult(){
  return state.difficulty==='facile' ? 0.6 : state.difficulty==='difficile' ? 1.7 : 1.0;
}
function setTimeMode(mode){
  state.timeMode = mode;
  document.querySelectorAll('#timeSeg > div').forEach(d=>d.classList.toggle('on', d.dataset.timemode===mode));
  document.getElementById('chronoRow').style.display = mode==='chrono' ? 'flex' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('timeModeLabel').textContent = mode==='chrono' ? 'Mode chronométré' : 'Mode continu';
}

function loadAllConfigs(){
  try{ return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) || '{}'); }catch(e){ return {}; }
}
function saveMsg(t){ const e=document.getElementById('saveMsg'); if(e){ e.textContent=t; clearTimeout(window.__saveMsgT); window.__saveMsgT=setTimeout(()=>{e.textContent='';},4000); } }
function renderSavedList(){
  const all = loadAllConfigs();
  const wrap = document.getElementById('savedList');
  wrap.innerHTML = '';
  Object.keys(all).forEach(name=>{
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'saveditem';
    const nm = document.createElement('span'); nm.className='name'; nm.textContent = name;
    const acts = document.createElement('span'); acts.className='acts';
    const mk = (txt, cls, fn)=>{ const e=document.createElement('span'); e.textContent=txt; if(cls) e.className=cls; e.onclick=fn; return e; };
    acts.appendChild(mk('charger','',()=>loadConfigByName(name)));
    acts.appendChild(mk('copier','',()=>copyConfigByName(name)));
    acts.appendChild(mk('suppr.','del',()=>deleteConfigByName(name)));
    row.appendChild(nm); row.appendChild(acts);
    wrap.appendChild(row);
  });
}
function encodeConfig(cfg, name){
  const json = JSON.stringify({n:name, c:cfg});
  const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(json);
  let bin=''; bytes.forEach(b=>bin+=String.fromCharCode(b));
  return 'TACTI2:' + btoa(bin);
}
function decodeConfig(code){
  code = (code||'').trim();
  const v2 = code.startsWith('TACTI2:'), v1 = code.startsWith('TACTI1:');
  if(!v1 && !v2) throw new Error('format');
  const bin = atob(code.slice(7).replace(/\s+/g,''));
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
  for(let i=0;i<bin.length;i++) bytes[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i);
  const obj = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(bytes));
  const cfg = v2 ? obj.c : obj;
  const name = v2 ? String(obj.n||'').trim() : '';
  if(!cfg || typeof cfg!=='object' || !cfg.modules) throw new Error('contenu');
  return {cfg, name};
}
function copyText(text){
  if(navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext){
    return navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
  }
  return new Promise((res,rej)=>{
    const ta=document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value=text; ta.style.position='fixed'; ta.style.opacity='0';
    document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select();
    let ok=false; try{ ok=document.execCommand('copy'); }catch(e){}
    document.body.removeChild(ta);
    ok?res():rej();
  });
}
function copyConfigByName(name){
  const all = loadAllConfigs();
  if(!all[name]) return;
  const code = encodeConfig(all[name], name);
  copyText(code).then(
    ()=>saveMsg('Code de « '+name+' » copié. Colle-le dans une note.'),
    ()=>{ window.prompt('Copie ce code (Ctrl+C) :', code); }
  );
}
function importConfig(){
  const input = document.getElementById('importCode');
  let cfg, codeName;
  try{ ({cfg, name:codeName} = decodeConfig(input.value)); }
  catch(e){ saveMsg('Code invalide : colle le texte complet commençant par TACTI'); return; }
  const typed = document.getElementById('saveName').value.trim();
  const all = loadAllConfigs();
  let name = codeName || typed || 'Importée';
  if(!typed || codeName){ let i=2; const base=name; while(all[name]) name = base+' ('+(i++)+')'; }
  all[name] = cfg;
  localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(all));
  input.value=''; document.getElementById('saveName').value='';
  renderSavedList();
  applyConfig(cfg);
  saveMsg('Configuration « '+name+' » importée et chargée.');
}
function saveConfig(){
  const name = document.getElementById('saveName').value.trim();
  if(!name){ return; }
  const all = loadAllConfigs();
  all[name] = collectConfig();
  localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(all));
  document.getElementById('saveName').value = '';
  renderSavedList();
}
function loadConfigByName(name){
  const all = loadAllConfigs();
  if(all[name]) applyConfig(all[name]);
}

  delete all[name];
  localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(all));
  renderSavedList();
}

/* =========================================================
   MOTEUR AUDIO (Web Audio API — sons synthétisés, 100% local)
   ========================================================= */
let actx = null;
function ensureAudio(){ if(!actx) actx = new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(); return actx; }

function noiseBuffer(ctx, duration){
  const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, Math.max(1, Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate*duration)), ctx.sampleRate);
  const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
  for(let i=0;i<d.length;i++) d[i] = (Math.random()*2-1);
  return buf;
}

// panner: -1 (gauche) .. 0 (centre) .. 1 (droite)
function makeOutputChain(ctx, gainVal, pan){
  const gain = ctx.createGain(); gain.gain.value = gainVal;
  const panner = ctx.createStereoPanner ? ctx.createStereoPanner() : null;
  if(panner){ panner.pan.value = pan; gain.connect(panner); panner.connect(ctx.destination); return gain; }
  gain.connect(ctx.destination); return gain;
}

function shotVolume(){ return (+document.getElementById('volShots').value)/100; }
function voiceVolume(){ return (+document.getElementById('volVoice').value)/100; }

/* ---- SONS DE TIR : 5 armes, enregistrements réels validés + synthèse ----
   Armes : AK-47, M16, M249, fusil à pompe, sniper.
   Types : coup par coup (1 ou 3 d'affilée) et rafale (1 ou 2 rafales enchaînées, même arme ou armes différentes). */
const SHOT_SAMPLES = {"ak47_R2":{"gain":0.79,"dur":1.92,"shot":""},"m16_R1":{"gain":0.9,"dur":1.36,"shot":""},"m16_R2":{"gain":0.9,"dur":1.57,"shot":""},"m249_R1":{"gain":0.88,"dur":0.77,"shot":""},"m249_R2":{"gain":0.88,"dur":1.48,"shot":""},"pompe_C":{"gain":1.0,"dur":2.28,"rackAt":2.063,"shot":"","rack":""},"sniper_A":{"gain":1.0,"dur":3.3,"shot":""}};

const SYN_BASE = {crackDur:.05, crack:1, hp:1500, lp:9000, bodyDur:.09, body:.7, bodyF:900,
                  thumpDur:.07, thump:.6, thumpF:250, tailDur:.2, tail:.14, wet:.25, rof:.1, n:6};
const WEAPONS = {
  ak47:  { synth:{hp:500, lp:2500, crack:.4, body:.7, thump:.8, tailDur:.7, tail:.4, wet:1.0, vg:.881}, real:['ak47_R2'] },
  m16:   { synth:{hp:700, lp:3000, crack:.45, body:.7, bodyF:800, thump:.7, tailDur:.7, tail:.4, wet:.9, rof:.075, n:8, vg:1.026}, real:['m16_R1','m16_R2'] },
  m249:  { synth:{hp:500, lp:3000, crack:.45, body:.9, thump:1.1, tailDur:.8, tail:.45, wet:.9, rof:.07, n:12, vg:.992}, real:['m249_R1','m249_R2'] },
  pompe: { sample:'pompe_C' },
  sniper:{ sample:'sniper_A' }
};

let shotBus = null, shotAssets = null;
const shotBufs = {};
function b64buf(b){ const s=atob(b), u=new Uint8Array(s.length); for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++) u[i]=s.charCodeAt(i); return u.buffer; }
function makeIR(ctx, sec, ex){
  const len = Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate*sec), buf = ctx.createBuffer(2, len, ctx.sampleRate);
  for(let c=0;c<2;c++){
    const d = buf.getChannelData(c); let s = 0;
    for(let i=0;i<len;i++){ s = s*0.6 + (Math.random()*2-1)*0.4; d[i] = s*Math.pow(1-i/len, ex); }
  }
  return buf;
}
function initShotBus(){
  if(shotBus) return shotBus;
  const ctx = ensureAudio();
  const comp = ctx.createDynamicsCompressor();
  comp.threshold.value=-14; comp.knee.value=10; comp.ratio.value=8; comp.attack.value=0.002; comp.release.value=0.12;
  comp.connect(ctx.destination);
  const noise = ctx.createBuffer(1, ctx.sampleRate*2, ctx.sampleRate);
  const nd = noise.getChannelData(0); for(let i=0;i<nd.length;i++) nd[i] = Math.random()*2-1;
  const n=1024, curve = new Float32Array(n);
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){ const x=i*2/(n-1)-1; curve[i]=Math.tanh(x*3.2)/Math.tanh(3.2); }
  shotBus = { comp, noise, curve, ir: makeIR(ctx, 1.6, 3.2) };
  return shotBus;
}
function loadShotSamples(){
  if(shotAssets) return shotAssets;
  const ctx = ensureAudio();
  shotAssets = Promise.all(Object.keys(SHOT_SAMPLES).map(async k=>{
    const s = SHOT_SAMPLES[k]; shotBufs[k] = {};
    try{
      shotBufs[k].shot = await ctx.decodeAudioData(b64buf(s.shot));
      if(s.rack) shotBufs[k].rack = await ctx.decodeAudioData(b64buf(s.rack));
    }catch(e){}
  }));
  return shotAssets;
}

// un "évènement" sonore : niveau + spatialisation + réverbération, puis compresseur commun
function makeEvent(pan, wet, vg){
  const ctx = actx; const bus = initShotBus();
  const out = ctx.createGain(); out.gain.value = shotVolume()*0.85*(vg||1);
  if(ctx.createStereoPanner){ const pn = ctx.createStereoPanner(); pn.pan.value = pan; out.connect(pn); pn.connect(bus.comp); }
  else out.connect(bus.comp);
  const input = ctx.createGain(); input.connect(out);
  if(wet>0){
    const w = ctx.createGain(); w.gain.value = wet;
    const cv = ctx.createConvolver(); cv.buffer = bus.ir;
    input.connect(w); w.connect(cv); cv.connect(out);
  }
  return { input, out };
}

const jit = (v,a)=> v*(1 + (Math.random()*2-1)*a);
function nzBurst(t0, out, o){
  const ctx = actx, bus = shotBus;
  const s = ctx.createBufferSource(); s.buffer = bus.noise;
  s.start(t0, Math.random()*(bus.noise.duration - o.dur - 0.1)); s.stop(t0 + o.dur + 0.02);
  let node = s;
  (o.filters||[]).forEach(f=>{
    const b = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); b.type = f.type;
    b.frequency.setValueAtTime(f.f, t0);
    if(f.fEnd) b.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(f.fEnd, t0 + o.dur);
    if(f.q !== undefined) b.Q.value = f.q;
    node.connect(b); node = b;
  });
  if(o.drive){ const ws = ctx.createWaveShaper(); ws.curve = bus.curve; node.connect(ws); node = ws; }
  const g = ctx.createGain();
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t0);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(o.gain, 0.0002), t0 + (o.attack||0.001));
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + o.dur);
  node.connect(g); g.connect(out);
}
function synthShot(t, out, p){
  nzBurst(t, out, {dur:p.crackDur, attack:.0005, gain:jit(p.crack,.1), drive:true,
    filters:[{type:'highpass', f:jit(p.hp,.05)}, {type:'lowpass', f:p.lp}]});
  nzBurst(t, out, {dur:p.bodyDur, attack:.001, gain:jit(p.body,.1),
    filters:[{type:'bandpass', f:jit(p.bodyF,.05), q:.8}]});
  nzBurst(t, out, {dur:p.thumpDur, attack:.002, gain:jit(p.thump,.1),
    filters:[{type:'lowpass', f:p.thumpF, fEnd:p.thumpF*.35}]});
  nzBurst(t+.01, out, {dur:p.tailDur, attack:.005, gain:p.tail,
    filters:[{type:'lowpass', f:2500, fEnd:600}]});
}
function synthParams(w){ return Object.assign({}, SYN_BASE, WEAPONS[w].synth); }
function synthSingle(w, pan, t){
  const p = synthParams(w), ev = makeEvent(pan, p.wet, p.vg);
  synthShot(t, ev.input, p);
  return p.tailDur + .1;
}
function synthBurst(w, pan, t){
  const p = synthParams(w), ev = makeEvent(pan, p.wet, p.vg);
  const n = Math.max(3, p.n + Math.floor(Math.random()*4) - 1);
  let tt = t;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){ synthShot(tt, ev.input, p); tt += p.rof*(0.94+Math.random()*0.12); }
  return (tt - t) + p.tailDur;
}

// extrait réel (rafale AK/M16/M249, coup de pompe, coup de sniper) — retourne la durée, 0 si non chargé
function playSmp(key, part, pan, t){
  const b = shotBufs[key] && shotBufs[key][part];
  if(!b) return 0;
  const ctx = actx, ev = makeEvent(pan, 0, 1);
  const src = ctx.createBufferSource(); src.buffer = b;
  const g = ctx.createGain(); g.gain.value = SHOT_SAMPLES[key].gain;
  src.connect(g); g.connect(ev.out); src.start(t);
  return b.duration;
}
function pompeSeq(count, pan, t){
  let tt = t;
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
    const d = playSmp('pompe_C','shot',pan,tt);
    if(!d) return 0;
    if(i<count-1){
      const rb = shotBufs.pompe_C.rack, rd = rb ? rb.duration : 0.8;
      if(rb) playSmp('pompe_C','rack',pan,tt+0.9);
      tt += 0.9 + rd + 0.15;
    }
  }
  return (tt - t) + 1.5;
}
function sniperSeq(count, pan, t){
  let tt = t;
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
    const d = playSmp('sniper_A','shot',pan,tt);
    if(!d) return 0;
    if(i<count-1) tt += 1.6 + Math.random()*0.8;
  }
  return (tt - t) + 2.5;
}

const pickOf = arr => arr[Math.floor(Math.random()*arr.length)];
function chainSingleFreq(){ return (+document.getElementById('chainSingle').value) + fatigueLevel*2; }
function chainBurstFreq(){ return (+document.getElementById('chainBurst').value) + fatigueLevel*2; }

// définition des armes à pistes : id de piste -> libellé + source
const TRACKS = {
  ak47: [['E','Synthé · très lointain','synth'],['R2','Réel · plus lointain','ak47_R2']],
  m16:  [['E','Synthé · lointain','synth'],['R1','Réel · 3 courtes rafales','m16_R1'],['R2','Réel · longue rafale','m16_R2']],
  m249: [['E','Synthé · lointain','synth'],['R1','Réel · coup par coup','m249_R1'],['R2','Réel · rafale moyenne','m249_R2']]
};
const WEAPON_LABELS = {ak47:'AK-47', m16:'M16', m249:'M249', pompe:'Fusil à pompe (Massif)', sniper:'Sniper'};
function defaultShotCfg(){
  return {
    ak47:{on:true, single:true, burst:true, tracks:['E','R2']},
    m16:{on:true, single:true, burst:true, tracks:['E','R1','R2']},
    m249:{on:true, single:true, burst:true, tracks:['E','R1','R2']},
    pompe:{on:true, single:true, burst:true, tracks:[]},
    sniper:{on:true, single:true, burst:true, tracks:[]}
  };
}
function migrateShotCfg(cfg){
  const d = defaultShotCfg();
  if(cfg && cfg.shotCfg){
    Object.keys(d).forEach(w=>{ if(cfg.shotCfg[w]) d[w] = Object.assign(d[w], cfg.shotCfg[w]); });
    shotSyncBurst(d);
    return d;
  }
  if(cfg && cfg.weaponsSelected){
    const modes = cfg.shotModesSelected || ['single','burst'];
    Object.keys(d).forEach(w=>{ d[w].on = cfg.weaponsSelected.includes(w); d[w].single = modes.includes('single'); d[w].burst = modes.includes('burst'); });
  }
  shotSyncBurst(d);
  return d;
}
// pour les armes à pistes, il n'y a plus d'interrupteur « rafale » : une rafale est jouée dès qu'au moins une piste est cochée
// (ancienne config avec « rafale » décochée → on décoche aussi ses pistes)
function shotSyncBurst(d){
  Object.keys(TRACKS).forEach(w=>{ const c=d[w]; if(!c) return; if(c.burst===false) c.tracks=[]; c.burst = (c.tracks||[]).length>0; });
}
function shotCfgValid(){
  return Object.values(state.shotCfg).some(c=> c.on && (c.single || c.burst));
}
function trackSource(w, id){ const t = (TRACKS[w]||[]).find(x=>x[0]===id); return t ? t[2] : null; }

// coup par coup : 1 coup, ou 3 d'affilée selon la fréquence réglée (count forcé pour le test)
function playWeaponSingle(w, pan, t, count){
  if(!count) count = Math.random()*100 < chainSingleFreq() ? 3 : 1;
  if(w==='pompe') return pompeSeq(count, pan, t);
  if(w==='sniper') return sniperSeq(count, pan, t);
  let tt = t;
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){ synthSingle(w, pan, tt); tt += 0.24 + Math.random()*0.16; }
  return (tt - t) + 0.5;
}
// rafale : piste choisie parmi celles cochées (ou piste forcée pour le test)
function playWeaponBurst(w, pan, t, forced){
  if(w==='pompe') return pompeSeq(2 + Math.floor(Math.random()*2), pan, t);
  if(w==='sniper') return sniperSeq(2, pan, t);
  let src;
  if(forced) src = forced;
  else {
    const ids = (state.shotCfg[w].tracks||[]).map(id=>trackSource(w,id)).filter(Boolean);
    src = ids.length ? pickOf(ids) : 'synth';
  }
  if(src!=='synth'){ const d = playSmp(src, 'shot', pan, t); if(d) return d; }
  return synthBurst(w, pan, t);
}

function randomPan(){
  if(!state.flags.spatial) return 0;
  const r = Math.random();
  if(r < 0.34) return -0.85;
  if(r < 0.68) return 0.85;
  return 0; // tir "de face" reste centré
}

function fireShot(){
  const cfg = state.shotCfg;
  const ws = Object.keys(cfg).filter(w=>cfg[w].on && cfg[w].single);
  const wb = Object.keys(cfg).filter(w=>cfg[w].on && cfg[w].burst);
  if(!ws.length && !wb.length) return;
  initShotBus();
  let wSingle = 50, wBurst = 50 + fatigueLevel*5;
  if(state.difficulty==='difficile') wBurst += 18; else if(state.difficulty==='facile') wBurst -= 12;
  const pool = [];
  if(ws.length) for(let i=0;i<Math.max(5,wSingle);i++) pool.push('single');
  if(wb.length) for(let i=0;i<Math.max(5,wBurst);i++)  pool.push('burst');
  const mode = pickOf(pool), pan = randomPan();
  const t0 = actx.currentTime + 0.03;
  if(mode==='single'){ playWeaponSingle(pickOf(ws), pan, t0); return; }
  const w = pickOf(wb);
  const d = playWeaponBurst(w, pan, t0);
  // parfois deux rafales d'affilée : même arme, ou une autre arme à rafale activée
  if(Math.random()*100 < chainBurstFreq()){
    const others = wb.filter(x=>x!==w);
    const w2 = (others.length && Math.random()<0.5) ? pickOf(others) : w;
    playWeaponBurst(w2, pan, t0 + Math.min(d,2.2)*0.9 + 0.5 + Math.random()*0.7);
  }
}

/* ---- écoute / test depuis l'écran de réglages ---- */
function testShot(w, kind, src){
  const ctx = ensureAudio();
  if(ctx.state==='suspended') ctx.resume();
  initShotBus();
  loadShotSamples().then(()=>{
    const t = ctx.currentTime + 0.05;
    if(kind==='single') playWeaponSingle(w, 0, t, 1);
    else if(kind==='triple') playWeaponSingle(w, 0, t, 3);
    else if(kind==='track') playWeaponBurst(w, 0, t, src);
    else playWeaponBurst(w, 0, t);
  });
}
function renderWeaponCards(){
  const root = document.getElementById('weaponCards');
  if(!root) return;
  root.innerHTML = '';
  const mk = (tag, cls, txt)=>{ const e=document.createElement(tag); if(cls) e.className=cls; if(txt!=null) e.textContent=txt; return e; };
  // un élément cochable + son bouton ▶ d'écoute
  const item = (on, label, onToggle, onPlay, tip)=>{
    const grp = mk('span','tgrp'), chip = mk('span','chip'+(on?' on':''), label);
    chip.onclick = onToggle; if(tip) chip.title = tip;
    const b = mk('button','tbtn','▶'); b.type='button'; b.title = 'Écouter ce son'; b.onclick = onPlay;
    grp.appendChild(chip); grp.appendChild(b); return grp;
  };
  Object.keys(WEAPON_LABELS).forEach(w=>{
    const c = state.shotCfg[w];
    const card = mk('div', 'wcard'+(c.on?'':' off'));
    const title = mk('span','chip'+(c.on?' on':''), WEAPON_LABELS[w]);
    title.onclick = ()=>{ c.on = !c.on; renderWeaponCards(); };
    card.appendChild(title);
    const col = mk('div','wcol');
    const items = [item(c.single, 'Coup par coup', ()=>{ c.single = !c.single; renderWeaponCards(); }, ()=> testShot(w,'single'))];
    if(TRACKS[w]){
      TRACKS[w].forEach(([id,label,src])=>{
                items.push(item(c.tracks.includes(id), label,
          ()=>{ const k=c.tracks.indexOf(id); if(k>=0) c.tracks.splice(k,1); else c.tracks.push(id); c.burst = c.tracks.length>0; renderWeaponCards(); },
          ()=> testShot(w,'track',src), label));
      });
    } else {
      items.push(item(c.burst, 'Série (2-3 tirs)', ()=>{ c.burst = !c.burst; renderWeaponCards(); }, ()=> testShot(w,'burst')));
    }
    // 1 ou 2 tracks : tout sur la ligne de l'arme ; plus : « coup par coup » + 1re piste sur la ligne de l'arme, le reste dessous (aligné sous les sons)
    const first = items.length<=3 ? items.length : 2;
    const r1 = mk('div','wrow'); items.slice(0,first).forEach(e=>r1.appendChild(e)); col.appendChild(r1);
    if(items.length>first){ const r2 = mk('div','wrow'); items.slice(first).forEach(e=>r2.appendChild(e)); col.appendChild(r2); }
    card.appendChild(col);
    root.appendChild(card);
  });
}

/* voix off — annonces couleurs & ordres, jamais spatialisées */
/* File d'attente vocale : une annonce n'en coupe plus une autre, elles se suivent. */
const voiceQueue = [];
let voiceBusy = false, voiceGen = 0;
function speak(text, onend){
  if(!('speechSynthesis' in window)){ if(onend) onend(); return; }
  voiceQueue.push({ text, onend });
  if(voiceQueue.length > 6){ const old = voiceQueue.shift(); if(old.onend) old.onend(); }
  if(!voiceBusy) nextVoice();
}
function nextVoice(){
  const item = voiceQueue.shift();
  if(!item){ voiceBusy = false; return; }
  voiceBusy = true;
  const gen = voiceGen;
  const u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(item.text);
  u.lang = 'fr-FR'; u.rate = 1.0; u.pitch = 1.0;
  u.volume = voiceVolume();
  let done = false, guard = null;
  const finish = ()=>{
    if(done) return; done = true; clearTimeout(guard);
    if(item.onend) item.onend();
    if(gen === voiceGen) nextVoice();
  };
  u.onend = finish; u.onerror = finish;
  guard = setTimeout(finish, 12000); // filet de sécurité si la synthèse se bloque
  window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
}
function cancelVoice(){
  voiceGen++; voiceQueue.length = 0; voiceBusy = false;
  if(window.speechSynthesis) window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
}

/* drone continu pour "ne pas bouger" uniquement */
let droneNode = null, droneGain = null;
function startDrone(){
  const ctx = ensureAudio();
  droneNode = ctx.createOscillator(); droneNode.type='sine'; droneNode.frequency.value = 90;
  droneGain = ctx.createGain(); droneGain.gain.value = 0.0001;
  droneNode.connect(droneGain); droneGain.connect(ctx.destination);
  droneNode.start();
  droneGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.06*voiceVolume()+0.001, ctx.currentTime+0.4);
}
function stopDrone(){
  if(!droneNode) return;
  const ctx = ensureAudio();
  droneGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, ctx.currentTime+0.4);
  const n = droneNode;
  setTimeout(()=>{ try{n.stop();}catch(e){} }, 500);
  droneNode = null;
}

/* ---- AMBIANCE SONORE (boucles synthétisées, 100% locales) ----
   Banque facilement incrémentable : pour ajouter une ambiance, ajouter une clé à AMBIANCE_KEYS / AMBIANCE_LABELS
   et une fonction ambiance<Nom>(ctx, vol) ci-dessous qui retourne { stop() }.
   Pour brancher un jour de vrais fichiers audio libres de droits : remplacer le corps de la fonction par un
   <audio>/AudioBufferSourceNode chargé via fetch() + decodeAudioData() sur un fichier local embarqué. */
const ambianceNodes = {};
function ambianceVolume(){ return (+document.getElementById('ambianceVol').value)/100; }

/* ===== AMBIANCES v8 : synthèse par couches (buffers de moteur/rotor, bruit brun, réverbération de distance) ===== */
function ambPan(ctx,p){ if(ctx.createStereoPanner){const n=ctx.createStereoPanner(); n.pan.value=p; return n;} return ctx.createGain(); }
function ambReg(){ const set=new Set(); return { add(n){ set.add(n); n.onended=()=>set.delete(n); return n; }, stopAll(){ set.forEach(n=>{try{n.stop();}catch(e){}}); set.clear(); } }; }
function ambLoop(minMs,maxMs,fn,firstMs){
  let stopped=false,id=null;
  const arm=ms=>{ id=setTimeout(()=>{ if(stopped) return; if(!paused) fn(); arm(minMs+Math.random()*(maxMs-minMs)); },ms); };
  arm(firstMs!=null?firstMs:minMs+Math.random()*(maxMs-minMs));
  return { stop(){ stopped=true; clearTimeout(id); } };
}
const _ambCache=new WeakMap();
function ambBuf(ctx,key,make){ let c=_ambCache.get(ctx); if(!c){c={};_ambCache.set(ctx,c);} return c[key]||(c[key]=make()); }
function ambWet(ctx){ return ambBuf(ctx,'wet',()=>{
  const len=Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate*2.6), b=ctx.createBuffer(2,len,ctx.sampleRate);
  for(let c=0;c<2;c++){ const d=b.getChannelData(c); for(let i=0;i<len;i++) d[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*Math.pow(1-i/len,3.2); }
  const cv=ctx.createConvolver(); cv.buffer=b; const g=ctx.createGain(); g.connect(cv);
  const o=ctx.createGain(); o.gain.value=0.9; cv.connect(o); o.connect(ctx.destination); return g; }); }
function ambOut(ctx,node,wet){ const d=ctx.createGain(); d.gain.value=1-wet*0.6; node.connect(d); d.connect(ctx.destination);
  const s=ctx.createGain(); s.gain.value=wet; node.connect(s); s.connect(ambWet(ctx)); }
function ambBrown(ctx,sec){ const n=Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate*sec), b=ctx.createBuffer(1,n,ctx.sampleRate), d=b.getChannelData(0); let l=0;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){ l=(l+0.02*(Math.random()*2-1))/1.02; d[i]=l*3.5; } return b; }
function ambEngineBuf(ctx,hz,sec,heavy){ return ambBuf(ctx,'eng'+hz+heavy,()=>{
  const sr=ctx.sampleRate,n=Math.floor(sr*sec),b=ctx.createBuffer(1,n,sr),d=b.getChannelData(0),per=1/hz;
  for(let t=0;t<sec-per*0.5;t+=per*(1+(Math.random()-0.5)*0.12)){
    const a=0.6+Math.random()*0.4,s0=Math.floor(t*sr),L=Math.min(n-s0,Math.floor(sr*0.09));
    for(let i=0;i<L;i++){ const x=i/sr; d[s0+i]+=a*(Math.sin(6.283*(heavy?42:62)*x)*Math.exp(-x/0.035)+(Math.random()*2-1)*0.55*Math.exp(-x/0.007)); } }
  return b; }); }
function ambNote(ctx,reg,dst,t,f0,f1,dur,amp,harm){
  const o=reg.add(ctx.createOscillator()); o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f0,t); o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(f1,t+dur);
  const g=ctx.createGain(); g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,t); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(amp,t+Math.min(0.012,dur/3)); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+dur);
  o.connect(g); g.connect(dst); o.start(t); o.stop(t+dur+0.02);
  if(harm){ const o2=reg.add(ctx.createOscillator()); o2.frequency.setValueAtTime(f0*2,t); o2.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(f1*2,t+dur);
    const g2=ctx.createGain(); g2.gain.value=harm; o2.connect(g2); g2.connect(g); o2.start(t); o2.stop(t+dur+0.02); } }
function ambClick(ctx,reg,dst,t,f,q,dur,amp){
  const s=reg.add(ctx.createBufferSource()); s.buffer=ambBuf(ctx,'clk',()=>noiseBuffer(ctx,0.3));
  const b=ctx.createBiquadFilter(); b.type='bandpass'; b.frequency.value=f; b.Q.value=q;
  const g=ctx.createGain(); g.gain.setValueAtTime(amp,t); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+dur);
  s.connect(b); b.connect(g); g.connect(dst); s.start(t,Math.random()*0.15); s.stop(t+dur+0.02); }
function ambNoiseLoop(ctx,reg,kind){ const s=reg.add(ctx.createBufferSource()); s.buffer=kind==='brown'?ambBuf(ctx,'brown12',()=>ambBrown(ctx,12)):ambBuf(ctx,'white4',()=>noiseBuffer(ctx,4)); s.loop=true; return s; }

/* --- Circulation : grondement de ville, voitures qui passent (effet Doppler), klaxon lointain --- */
function playCar(ctx,vol,reg){
  const t=ctx.currentTime+0.05,dur=3+Math.random()*3,dir=Math.random()<0.5?-1:1,A=vol*(0.3+Math.random()*0.5);
  const pan=ambPan(ctx,-0.8*dir); if(pan.pan) pan.pan.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.8*dir,t+dur);
  const env=ctx.createGain(); env.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,t); env.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(A,t+dur*0.5); env.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+dur);
  const n=ambNoiseLoop(ctx,reg,'white'), bp=ctx.createBiquadFilter(); bp.type='bandpass'; bp.Q.value=0.8;
  bp.frequency.setValueAtTime(450,t); bp.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(1100,t+dur*0.5); bp.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(500,t+dur);
  const ng=ctx.createGain(); ng.gain.value=0.5; n.connect(bp); bp.connect(ng); ng.connect(env);
  const e=reg.add(ctx.createBufferSource()); e.buffer=ambEngineBuf(ctx,32,3,false); e.loop=true;
  e.playbackRate.setValueAtTime(1.1,t); e.playbackRate.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.9,t+dur);
  const lp=ctx.createBiquadFilter(); lp.type='lowpass'; lp.frequency.value=700; e.connect(lp); lp.connect(env);
  env.connect(pan); ambOut(ctx,pan,0.2); n.start(t,Math.random()*2); n.stop(t+dur+0.1); e.start(t); e.stop(t+dur+0.1);
}
function ambianceCirculation(ctx,vol){
  const reg=ambReg();
  const b=ambNoiseLoop(ctx,reg,'brown'), bl=ctx.createBiquadFilter(); bl.type='lowpass'; bl.frequency.value=200; const bg=ctx.createGain(); bg.gain.value=vol*0.55;
  b.connect(bl); bl.connect(bg); bg.connect(ctx.destination); b.start();
  const h=ambNoiseLoop(ctx,reg,'white'), hl=ctx.createBiquadFilter(); hl.type='lowpass'; hl.frequency.value=1400; const hg=ctx.createGain(); hg.gain.value=vol*0.035;
  h.connect(hl); hl.connect(hg); hg.connect(ctx.destination); h.start();
  const cars=ambLoop(2500,8000,()=>playCar(ctx,vol,reg),800);
  const horn=ambLoop(30000,70000,()=>{ const t=ctx.currentTime+0.05,bus=ctx.createGain(),pan=ambPan(ctx,Math.random()*1.4-0.7); bus.connect(pan);
    ambNote(ctx,reg,bus,t,420,418,0.3,vol*0.05,0.5); ambNote(ctx,reg,bus,t,530,528,0.3,vol*0.04,0.5); ambOut(ctx,pan,0.6); },15000);
  return { stop(){ cars.stop(); horn.stop(); reg.stopAll(); } };
}

const AMBIANCE_FN = { circulation:ambianceCirculation }; // les autres ambiances sont de vrais enregistrements (AMB_DATA)

/* --- Sons perso : ajoutés à la liste comme des ambiances à part entière (nommés, supprimables, mémorisés hors-ligne dans le navigateur via IndexedDB) --- */
const AMB_LEGACY_KEYS = ["generateur","orage","circulation","animaux","helicoptere","vehicules","brouhaha"];
function ambDb(){ return new Promise((res,rej)=>{ const r=indexedDB.open('tacti_amb_files',1); r.onupgradeneeded=()=>r.result.createObjectStore('f'); r.onsuccess=()=>res(r.result); r.onerror=()=>rej(r.error); }); }
async function ambDbGet(k){ try{ const db=await ambDb(); return await new Promise(res=>{ const q=db.transaction('f').objectStore('f').get(k); q.onsuccess=()=>res(q.result); q.onerror=()=>res(null); }); }catch(e){ return null; } }
async function ambDbPut(k,v){ const db=await ambDb(); await new Promise((res,rej)=>{ const tx=db.transaction('f','readwrite'); if(v) tx.objectStore('f').put(v,k); else tx.objectStore('f').delete(k); tx.oncomplete=res; tx.onerror=()=>rej(tx.error); }); }
async function ambCustomLoad(){
  try{
    const db=await ambDb();
    const recs=await new Promise(res=>{ const out=[]; const q=db.transaction('f').objectStore('f').openCursor(); q.onsuccess=()=>{ const c=q.result; if(c){ out.push({k:c.key,v:c.value}); c.continue(); } else res(out); }; q.onerror=()=>res(out); });
    // migration : anciens sons qui remplaçaient une ambiance → deviennent des sons perso indépendants
    for(const r of recs){ if(AMB_LEGACY_KEYS.includes(r.k) && r.v && r.v.data){
      const nk='perso:'+Date.now().toString(36)+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,5);
      try{ await ambDbPut(nk,{name:r.v.name,data:r.v.data}); await ambDbPut(r.k,null); recs.push({k:nk,v:{name:r.v.name}}); }catch(e){} } }
    customAmb = recs.filter(r=>String(r.k).startsWith('perso:') && r.v).map(r=>({key:r.k,name:r.v.name||'Son perso'})).sort((a,b)=>a.key<b.key?-1:1);
  }catch(e){ customAmb=[]; }
  customAmbLoaded=true;
  Array.from(state.ambianceSelected).forEach(k=>{ if(k.startsWith('perso:') && !customAmb.some(c=>c.key===k)) state.ambianceSelected.delete(k); });
  renderAmbianceChips();
}
function renderAmbianceChips(){
  const wrap=document.getElementById('ambianceChips'); if(!wrap) return;
  wrap.querySelectorAll('.chip').forEach(c=>c.remove());
  const items=AMBIANCE_KEYS.map(k=>({key:k,name:AMBIANCE_LABELS[k],perso:false})).concat(customAmb.map(c=>({key:c.key,name:c.name,perso:true})));
  items.forEach(it=>{
    const el=document.createElement('span'); el.className='chip'+(it.perso?' perso':'')+(state.ambianceSelected.has(it.key)?' on':''); el.dataset.amb=it.key;
    const lab=document.createElement('span'); lab.textContent=it.name; el.appendChild(lab);
    if(it.perso){ const x=document.createElement('span'); x.className='chipx'; x.textContent='✕'; x.title='Supprimer ce son'; x.onclick=ev=>{ ev.stopPropagation(); ambCustomDelete(it.key); }; el.appendChild(x); }
    el.onclick=()=>{ el.classList.toggle('on'); if(el.classList.contains('on')) state.ambianceSelected.add(it.key); else state.ambianceSelected.delete(it.key); };
    wrap.appendChild(el);
  });
}
async function ambCustomDelete(key){
  const c=customAmb.find(x=>x.key===key); if(!c) return;
  if(!confirm('Supprimer le son « '+c.name+' » ?')) return;
  try{ await ambDbPut(key,null); }catch(e){ alert('Suppression impossible.'); return; }
  customAmb=customAmb.filter(x=>x.key!==key); state.ambianceSelected.delete(key); renderAmbianceChips();
}
async function ambCustomAdd(f){
  let buf; try{ buf=await f.arrayBuffer(); await ensureAudio().decodeAudioData(buf.slice(0)); }catch(e){ alert('Ce fichier audio est illisible.'); return; }
  const def=f.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/,''); const name=(prompt('Nom de ce son :',def)||'').trim()||def;
  const key='perso:'+Date.now().toString(36)+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,5);
  try{ await ambDbPut(key,{name:name,data:buf}); }catch(e){ alert('Impossible de stocker ce fichier.'); return; }
  customAmb.push({key:key,name:name}); state.ambianceSelected.add(key); renderAmbianceChips();
}
document.getElementById('ambFile').onchange=e=>{ const f=e.target.files[0]; e.target.value=''; if(f) ambCustomAdd(f); };
ambCustomLoad();

async function startAmbiance(key){
  const ctx=ensureAudio();
  if(key.startsWith('perso:')){
    const data=await ambDbGet(key); if(!running||!data) return;
    try{ const buf=await ctx.decodeAudioData(data.data.slice(0)); if(!running) return;
      const src=ctx.createBufferSource(); src.buffer=buf; src.loop=true; const g=ctx.createGain(); g.gain.value=ambianceVolume();
      src.connect(g); g.connect(ctx.destination); src.start(); ambianceNodes[key]={ stop(){ try{src.stop();}catch(e){} } }; }catch(e){}
    return; }
  if(AMB_DATA[key]){
    try{ const buf=await ambRealBuf(ctx,key); if(!running||!buf) return;
      const src=ctx.createBufferSource(); src.buffer=buf; src.loop=true; const g=ctx.createGain(); g.gain.value=ambianceVolume();
      src.connect(g); g.connect(ctx.destination); src.start(); ambianceNodes[key]={ stop(){ try{src.stop();}catch(e){} } }; }catch(e){}
    return; }
  const fn=AMBIANCE_FN[key]; if(fn) ambianceNodes[key]=fn(ctx,ambianceVolume());
}
/* Vrais enregistrements intégrés au fichier (mp3 en base64, décodés une seule fois puis gardés) */
const ambRealCache = {};
function ambRealBuf(ctx,key){
  if(!ambRealCache[key]){ const bin=atob(AMB_DATA[key]),u=new Uint8Array(bin.length); for(let i=0;i<bin.length;i++) u[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i);
    ambRealCache[key]=ctx.decodeAudioData(u.buffer).catch(e=>{ delete ambRealCache[key]; return null; }); }
  return ambRealCache[key];
}
function stopAllAmbiance(){
  Object.keys(ambianceNodes).forEach(k=>{ try{ambianceNodes[k].stop();}catch(e){} delete ambianceNodes[k]; });
}

/* =========================================================
   MOTEUR DE SESSION
   ========================================================= */
const ORDER_LABELS = {
  couche:'Couché', genoux:'À genoux', accroupi:'Accroupi', fige:'Ne pas bouger',
  avancer:'Avancer', reculer:'Reculer', bouger:'Bouger',
  abri:"Homme à terre, mettez-le à l'abri", couverture:'Je couvre'
};
const MOVE_ORDERS = ['avancer','reculer','bouger','abri'];
const BLOCKING_ORDERS = ['fige', ...MOVE_ORDERS];
const SHOT_BLOCKING_ORDERS = ['couverture']; // coupe les tirs, laisse passer les couleurs

const COLOR_HEX = {Rouge:'#7a1f18',Bleu:'#173d6b',Vert:'#1f5c26',Jaune:'#7a6a12',Orange:'#7a4712',Violet:'#4a1f6b',Noir:'#2b2b2b',Blanc:'#dedad0',Brun:'#4a3220',Rose:'#8a4a63',Gris:'#55585a'};
function colorToHex(name){ return COLOR_HEX[name]; }
function colorToTextColor(name){ return name==='Blanc' ? '#141712' : 'rgba(255,255,255,.92)'; }

let sessionTimers = [];
let running = false, paused = false;
let sessionStartTime = 0, pauseAccum = 0, pauseStartedAt = 0;
let chronoTotalMs = 0;
let fatigueLevel = 0;
let fatigueTicker = null;
let clockTicker = null;
const blockReasons = new Set(); // bloque uniquement les annonces de couleur ('order' | 'reload')
let blockLabel = '';
const shotBlockReasons = new Set(); // coupe uniquement les sons de tir ('cover')
let shotBlockLabel = '';
let extractionActive = false;      // un repli est en cours
let orderActive = false;           // un ordre de mouvement est en cours
/* Verrou des événements "lourds" (ordre, rechargement, blessure, changement d'arme, repli) :
   un seul à la fois, avec une courte marge après chacun, sinon le suivant attend son tour. */
const heavyActive = new Set();
let heavyFreeAt = 0;
const HEAVY_GAP_MS = 2500;
function heavyStart(k){ heavyActive.add(k); }
function heavyEnd(k){ heavyActive.delete(k); heavyFreeAt = Date.now() + HEAVY_GAP_MS; }
function heavyBusy(){ return heavyActive.size>0 || Date.now() < heavyFreeAt; }
function heavyRetryDelay(){ return 1000 + Math.random()*1500; }

let prepCurrentExercise = null;
let prepSeriesEndAt = 0;
let prepDisplayTicker = null;

function clearAllTimers(){ sessionTimers.forEach(t=>clearTimeout(t)); sessionTimers = []; }
function schedule(fn, delayMs){ const id = setTimeout(fn, delayMs); sessionTimers.push(id); return id; }
function randRange(min,max){ return min + Math.random()*(max-min); }
function fatigueMult(){ return Math.max(0.15, 1 - (fatigueLevel*0.10)); }

function addBlock(reason, label){ blockReasons.add(reason); if(label) blockLabel = label; updateStatusLine(); }
function removeBlock(reason){ blockReasons.delete(reason); if(blockReasons.size===0) blockLabel=''; updateStatusLine(); }
function addShotBlock(reason, label){ shotBlockReasons.add(reason); if(label) shotBlockLabel = label; updateStatusLine(); }
function removeShotBlock(reason){ shotBlockReasons.delete(reason); if(shotBlockReasons.size===0) shotBlockLabel=''; updateStatusLine(); }

function startSession(){
  if(state.modules.colors && state.colorsSelected.size===0){
    alert("Sélectionnez au moins une couleur, ou désactivez le module Cibles/Couleurs.");
    return;
  }
  if(state.modules.shots && !shotCfgValid()){
    alert("Activez au moins une arme avec au moins un son coché, ou désactivez le module Sons de tir.");
    return;
  }
  if(state.modules.ambiance && state.ambianceSelected.size===0){
    alert("Sélectionnez au moins une ambiance, ou désactivez le module Ambiance sonore.");
    return;
  }
  if(state.prepPhysique && state.prepExercisesSelected.size===0){
    alert("Sélectionnez au moins un exercice pour la préparation physique.");
    return;
  }
  if(state.modules.injuries && state.injuriesSelected.size===0){
    alert("Sélectionnez au moins une blessure, ou désactivez le module Blessures simulées.");
    return;
  }
  if(state.modules.switch && !state.prepPhysique && state.switchSelected.size<2){
    alert("Sélectionnez au moins deux armes pour le changement d'arme, ou désactivez le module.");
    return;
  }
  ensureAudio();
  if(actx.state==='suspended') actx.resume();
  initShotBus(); loadShotSamples();

  fatigueLevel = 0; paused = false; running = true;
  blockReasons.clear(); blockLabel = '';
  shotBlockReasons.clear(); shotBlockLabel = ''; extractionActive = false; orderActive = false; heavyActive.clear(); heavyFreeAt = 0;
  pauseAccum = 0; sessionStartTime = Date.now();

  chronoTotalMs = state.timeMode==='chrono' ? (parseInt(document.getElementById('chronoMin').value)||5)*60000 : 0;

  document.getElementById('session').classList.add('live');
  document.getElementById('sessWord').textContent = '';
  document.getElementById('sessHint').textContent = 'SESSION EN COURS';
  document.getElementById('sessExercise').classList.toggle('show', state.prepPhysique);
  updateStatusLine();

  clockTicker = setInterval(updateClock, 250);

  if(state.modules.fatigue && !state.prepPhysique){
    fatigueTicker = setInterval(()=>{
      if(paused) return;
      fatigueLevel = Math.min(9, fatigueLevel+1);
      updateStatusLine();
    }, 30000);
  }

  if(state.modules.ambiance){
    Array.from(state.ambianceSelected).forEach(k=> startAmbiance(k));
  }

  if(state.modules.shots && !state.prepPhysique) scheduleNextShot();
  if(state.modules.colors) scheduleNextColor();
  if(state.modules.orders && !state.prepPhysique) scheduleNextOrder();
  if(state.modules.decoys && !state.prepPhysique) scheduleNextDecoy();
  if(state.modules.reload && !state.prepPhysique) scheduleNextReload();
  if(state.modules.injuries && !state.prepPhysique) scheduleNextInjury();
  currentWeapon = null; hideWeapon();
  if(state.modules.switch && !state.prepPhysique) scheduleNextSwitch();
  if(state.modules.extraction && !state.prepPhysique) scheduleFirstExtraction();
  if(state.prepPhysique) startPrepSeries();

  if('mediaSession' in navigator){
    try{
      navigator.mediaSession.setActionHandler('play', ()=>{ if(paused) togglePause(); });
      navigator.mediaSession.setActionHandler('pause', ()=>{ if(!paused) togglePause(); });
      navigator.mediaSession.playbackState = 'playing';
    }catch(e){}
  }
}

function updateStatusLine(){
  const el = document.getElementById('sessStatus');
  const f = state.modules.fatigue ? `fatigue: +${fatigueLevel*10}%` : 'fatigue: off';
  el.textContent = f + (blockLabel ? '\n'+blockLabel : '') + (shotBlockLabel ? '\n'+shotBlockLabel : '');
}

function updateClock(){
  const el = document.getElementById('sessTimer');
  if(state.prepPhysique){
    const remain = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((prepSeriesEndAt - Date.now())/1000));
    const mm = String(Math.floor(remain/60)).padStart(2,'0');
    const ss = String(remain%60).padStart(2,'0');
    document.getElementById('sessExercise').textContent = `${PREP_LABELS[prepCurrentExercise]||''} — ${mm}:${ss}`;
  }
  if(state.timeMode==='continu'){ el.textContent = '∞'; return; }
  const elapsed = (Date.now() - sessionStartTime - pauseAccum);
  const remain = Math.max(0, chronoTotalMs - elapsed);
  const s = Math.ceil(remain/1000);
  const mm = String(Math.floor(s/60)).padStart(2,'0');
  const ss = String(s%60).padStart(2,'0');
  el.textContent = `${mm}:${ss}`;
  if(remain<=0) quitSession();
}

/* ---- SONS DE TIR ---- */
function scheduleNextShot(){
  if(!running) return;
  const min = +document.getElementById('shotMin').value, max = +document.getElementById('shotMax').value;
  const delay = randRange(min,max) * 1000 * fatigueMult() * difficultyMult();
  schedule(()=>{
    if(!paused && running && shotBlockReasons.size===0){ fireShot(); }
    scheduleNextShot();
  }, delay);
}

/* ---- COULEURS ---- */
function colorIntervalRange(){
  if(state.prepPhysique) return [+document.getElementById('prepColorMin').value, +document.getElementById('prepColorMax').value];
  return [+document.getElementById('colorMin').value, +document.getElementById('colorMax').value];
}
function scheduleNextColor(){
  if(!running) return;
  const [min,max] = colorIntervalRange();
  const mult = state.prepPhysique ? 1 : (fatigueMult() * difficultyMult());
  const delay = randRange(min,max) * 1000 * mult;
  schedule(()=>{
    if(!paused && running && blockReasons.size===0){
      const multiFreq = state.modules.multi ? (+document.getElementById('multiFreq').value) : 0;
      if(state.modules.multi && !state.prepPhysique && Math.random()*100 < multiFreq){
        fireMultiTarget(()=> scheduleNextColor());
        return;
      } else {
        fireSingleTarget();
      }
    }
    scheduleNextColor();
  }, delay);
}
function fireSingleTarget(){
  const arr = Array.from(state.colorsSelected);
  if(arr.length===0) return;
  const c = arr[Math.floor(Math.random()*arr.length)];
  announceColor(c);
}
function fireMultiTarget(afterBattement){
  const arr = Array.from(state.colorsSelected);
  if(arr.length===0){ afterBattement(); return; }
  const count = Math.min(arr.length, 2 + Math.floor(Math.random()*2)); // 2 ou 3
  const shuffled = [...arr].sort(()=>Math.random()-0.5).slice(0,count);
  shuffled.forEach((c,i)=>{
    schedule(()=> announceColor(c), i*1300);
  });
  const battMin = +document.getElementById('multiBattMin').value, battMax = +document.getElementById('multiBattMax').value;
  const totalDelay = shuffled.length*1300 + randRange(battMin,battMax)*1000;
  schedule(afterBattement, totalDelay);
}
function announceColor(c){
  speak(c);
  flashWord(c, false);
}
function flashWord(text, small){
  const w = document.getElementById('sessWord');
  w.textContent = text;
  w.classList.toggle('small', !!small);
  w.style.color = colorToTextColor(text);
  document.getElementById('session').style.backgroundColor = colorToHex(text) || '#111';
  clearTimeout(window.__wordClear);
  window.__wordClear = setTimeout(()=>{
    document.getElementById('session').style.backgroundColor = '#000';
    document.getElementById('sessWord').textContent='';
  }, 1600);
}

/* ---- LEURRES : indépendants, mêmes annonces, sans lien avec le terrain réel ---- */
function scheduleNextDecoy(){
  if(!running) return;
  const delay = randRange(18,35) * 1000 * difficultyMult();
  schedule(()=>{
    if(!paused && running && blockReasons.size===0){
      const freq = ((+document.getElementById('decoyFreq').value) + fatigueLevel*5) * difficultyDecoyMult();
      if(Math.random()*100 < freq){
        const c = ALL_COLORS[Math.floor(Math.random()*ALL_COLORS.length)];
        announceColor(c); // visuellement indiscernable — l'utilisateur doit vérifier le terrain
      }
    }
    scheduleNextDecoy();
  }, delay);
}

/* ---- ORDRES DE MOUVEMENT ---- */
function scheduleNextOrder(){
  if(!running) return;
  const min = +document.getElementById('orderMin').value, max = +document.getElementById('orderMax').value;
  const delay = randRange(min,max) * 1000 * difficultyMult();
  const fire = ()=>{
    if(!paused && running){
      if(extractionActive){ scheduleNextOrder(); return; } // le repli est lui-même le déplacement : pas d'autre ordre en parallèle
      if(heavyBusy()){ schedule(fire, heavyRetryDelay()); return; } // un autre événement est en cours : on attend son tour
      const pool = Array.from(state.ordersSelected);
      if(pool.length>0){
        triggerOrder(pool[Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length)]);
        return; // triggerOrder se charge de reprogrammer après sa propre durée
      }
    }
    scheduleNextOrder();
  };
  schedule(fire, delay);
}
function triggerOrder(o, opts){
  opts = opts || {};
  const isMove = MOVE_ORDERS.includes(o);
  const isBlocking = BLOCKING_ORDERS.includes(o);
  const isCover = SHOT_BLOCKING_ORDERS.includes(o);
  let duration;
  if(isMove){
    const mn = +document.getElementById('moveMin').value, mx = +document.getElementById('moveMax').value;
    duration = randRange(mn,mx);
  } else {
    const hn = +document.getElementById('holdMin').value, hx = +document.getElementById('holdMax').value;
    duration = state.flags.randomHold ? randRange(hn,hx) : hn;
  }
  if(opts.maxSec) duration = Math.min(duration, opts.maxSec);
  orderActive = true;
  heavyStart('order');
  speak(ORDER_LABELS[o]);
  flashWord(ORDER_LABELS[o], true);
  document.getElementById('session').style.backgroundColor = '#111';

  if(isBlocking) addBlock('order', ORDER_LABELS[o].toUpperCase());
  if(isCover) addShotBlock('cover', 'COUVERTURE — TIRS COUPÉS');
  if(o==='fige') startDrone();

  schedule(()=>{
    if(o==='fige') stopDrone();
    if(isBlocking) removeBlock('order');
    if(isCover) removeShotBlock('cover');
    orderActive = false;
    heavyEnd('order');
    if(!opts.noResched) scheduleNextOrder();
  }, duration*1000);
}

/* ---- RECHARGEMENT ---- */
function scheduleNextReload(){
  if(!running) return;
  const min = +document.getElementById('reloadMin').value, max = +document.getElementById('reloadMax').value;
  const delay = randRange(min,max) * 1000;
  const fire = ()=>{
    if(!paused && running){
      if(heavyBusy()){ schedule(fire, heavyRetryDelay()); return; } // on attend la fin de l'ordre / blessure / changement d'arme en cours
      heavyStart('reload');
      speak('Reloading');
      flashWord('Reloading', true);
      document.getElementById('session').style.backgroundColor = '#111';
      addBlock('reload', 'RELOADING');
      schedule(()=>{ removeBlock('reload'); heavyEnd('reload'); if(running && !paused) speak('Rechargement terminé'); }, 3000);
    }
    scheduleNextReload();
  };
  schedule(fire, delay);
}

/* ---- BLESSURES SIMULÉES ---- */
function scheduleNextInjury(){
  if(!running) return;
  const min = +document.getElementById('injuryMin').value, max = +document.getElementById('injuryMax').value;
  const delay = randRange(min,max) * 1000 * difficultyMult();
  const fire = ()=>{
    if(!paused && running){
      if(heavyBusy()){ schedule(fire, heavyRetryDelay()); return; }
      const pool = Array.from(state.injuriesSelected);
      if(pool.length>0){
        triggerInjury(pool[Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length)]);
        return; // triggerInjury se charge de reprogrammer après sa propre durée
      }
    }
    scheduleNextInjury();
  };
  schedule(fire, delay);
}
function triggerInjury(inj){
  const dn = +document.getElementById('injuryDurMin').value, dx = +document.getElementById('injuryDurMax').value;
  const duration = randRange(dn,dx);
  speak(INJURY_LABELS[inj]);
  flashWord(INJURY_LABELS[inj], true);
  document.getElementById('session').style.backgroundColor = '#111';

  addBlock('injury', INJURY_LABELS[inj].toUpperCase());
  heavyStart('injury');

  schedule(()=>{
    removeBlock('injury');
    heavyEnd('injury');
    if(running && !paused) speak('Fin de blessure');
    scheduleNextInjury();
  }, duration*1000);
}

/* ---- CHANGEMENT D'ARME ---- */
let currentWeapon = null;
function scheduleNextSwitch(){
  if(!running) return;
  const a = +document.getElementById('switchMin').value, b = +document.getElementById('switchMax').value;
  const delay = randRange(Math.min(a,b), Math.max(a,b)) * 1000 * difficultyMult();
  const fire = ()=>{
    if(!paused && running){
      if(heavyBusy()){ schedule(fire, heavyRetryDelay()); return; }
      const pool = Array.from(state.switchSelected).filter(k=>k!==currentWeapon);
      if(pool.length>0){
        triggerSwitch(pool[Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length)]);
        return; // triggerSwitch reprogramme après le temps de changement
      }
    }
    scheduleNextSwitch();
  };
  schedule(fire, delay);
}
function triggerSwitch(k){
  currentWeapon = k;
  const label = SWITCH_LABELS[k];
  speak(SWITCH_PHRASES[Math.floor(Math.random()*SWITCH_PHRASES.length)](k));
  flashWord(label, true);
  document.getElementById('session').style.backgroundColor = '#111';
  const ic = document.getElementById('sessWeaponIcon');
  ic.innerHTML = '<div class="cap">Change d\'arme</div>' + SWITCH_SVG[k]; ic.classList.add('show');
  clearTimeout(window.__iconClear);
  window.__iconClear = setTimeout(()=> ic.classList.remove('show'), 2200);
  const badge = document.getElementById('sessWeapon');
  badge.innerHTML = SWITCH_SVG[k] + '<span>' + label + '</span>';
  badge.classList.add('show');
  addBlock('switch', "CHANGEMENT D'ARME");
  heavyStart('switch');
  schedule(()=>{ removeBlock('switch'); heavyEnd('switch'); scheduleNextSwitch(); }, 3000);
}
function hideWeapon(){
  clearTimeout(window.__iconClear);
  const ic = document.getElementById('sessWeaponIcon'); if(ic){ ic.classList.remove('show'); ic.innerHTML=''; }
  const b = document.getElementById('sessWeapon'); if(b){ b.classList.remove('show'); b.innerHTML=''; }
}

/* ---- REPLI / EXTRACTION ---- */
const EXTR_COVER_CHANCE = 0.3; // chance (par repli) d'une couverture, un peu au-dessus du rythme normal des ordres
function setExtractionMode(mode){
  state.extrMode = mode;
  document.querySelectorAll('#extrModeSeg > div').forEach(d=>d.classList.toggle('on', d.dataset.extrmode===mode));
  document.getElementById('extrOnceRow').style.display = mode==='unique' ? 'flex' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('extrRecRow').style.display = mode==='recurrent' ? 'flex' : 'none';
}
function extrRange(idMin, idMax){
  const a = +document.getElementById(idMin).value, b = +document.getElementById(idMax).value;
  return [Math.min(a,b), Math.max(a,b)];
}
function scheduleFirstExtraction(){
  if(!running) return;
  if(state.extrMode==='unique'){
    const [mn,mx] = extrRange('extrOnceMin','extrOnceMax');
    schedule(triggerExtraction, randRange(mn,mx) * 60000);   // une seule fois dans la séance
  } else {
    scheduleNextExtraction();
  }
}
function scheduleNextExtraction(){
  if(!running) return;
  const [mn,mx] = extrRange('extrMin','extrMax');
  schedule(triggerExtraction, randRange(mn,mx) * 1000 * difficultyMult());
}
function triggerExtraction(){
  if(!running) return;
  if(paused){ schedule(triggerExtraction, 1000); return; }
  if(heavyBusy()){ schedule(triggerExtraction, heavyRetryDelay()); return; } // le repli attend la fin de l'événement en cours
  const [tn,tx] = extrRange('extrTimeMin','extrTimeMax');
  const secs = Math.max(3, Math.round(randRange(tn,tx)));
  const casualty = !!state.flags.extrCasualty && Math.random()*100 < (+document.getElementById('extrCasualtyFreq').value);
  const phrase = (casualty ? "Homme à terre, exfiltrez-le. " : "") + "Tu as " + secs + " secondes pour rejoindre le point d'exfiltration.";

  extractionActive = true;
  heavyStart('extraction');
  addBlock('extraction', casualty ? 'REPLI — HOMME À TERRE' : 'REPLI'); // bloque les annonces de couleur, pas les tirs
  flashWord(casualty ? 'Exfiltration' : 'Repli', true);
  document.getElementById('session').style.backgroundColor = '#111';

  // le décompte (et le bip) démarre quand la voix a fini d'annoncer le temps
  let started = false;
  const begin = ()=>{ if(started || !running || !extractionActive) return; started = true; runExtractionCountdown(secs); };
  speak(phrase, begin);
  schedule(begin, 8000); // filet de sécurité si la synthèse vocale ne signale pas sa fin
}
function extractionBeepInterval(frac){ return 950 * Math.pow(120/950, frac); } // 950 ms → 120 ms
function runExtractionCountdown(secs){
  const startMs = Date.now(), durMs = secs*1000;
  maybeScheduleExtractionCover(durMs);
  const loop = ()=>{
    if(!running || !extractionActive) return;
    const elapsed = Date.now() - startMs;
    if(elapsed >= durMs) return;
    if(!paused) playExtractionBeep();
    schedule(loop, extractionBeepInterval(elapsed/durMs));
  };
  loop();
  schedule(endExtraction, durMs);
}
function endExtraction(){
  extractionActive = false;        // fin silencieuse : la séance reprend son cours
  removeBlock('extraction');
  heavyEnd('extraction');
  if(running && state.extrMode==='recurrent') scheduleNextExtraction();
}
function maybeScheduleExtractionCover(durMs){
  const coverOn = state.modules.orders && state.ordersSelected.has('couverture');
  if(!coverOn || Math.random() >= EXTR_COVER_CHANCE) return;
  const at = durMs * (0.2 + Math.random()*0.4);
  schedule(()=>{
    if(!running || paused || !extractionActive || orderActive) return;
    const leftSec = (durMs - at)/1000;
    if(leftSec < 3) return;
    triggerOrder('couverture', {noResched:true, maxSec:leftSec-1});
  }, at);
}
function playExtractionBeep(){
  const ctx = ensureAudio();
  if(ctx.state==='suspended') ctx.resume();
  const t = ctx.currentTime;
  const o = ctx.createOscillator(); o.type = 'square'; o.frequency.value = 1000;
  const g = ctx.createGain();
  const peak = Math.max(0.0002, 0.2 * (+document.getElementById('extrBeepVol').value)/100);
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(peak, t+0.005);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t+0.07);
  o.connect(g); g.connect(ctx.destination);
  o.start(t); o.stop(t+0.09);
}
let extrTestTimers = [];
function testExtractionBeep(){ // 4 s de bips qui s'accélèrent, au volume réglé
  extrTestTimers.forEach(clearTimeout); extrTestTimers = [];
  const total = 4000; let el = 0;
  while(el < total){
    extrTestTimers.push(setTimeout(playExtractionBeep, el));
    el += extractionBeepInterval(el/total);
  }
}

/* ---- PRÉPARATION PHYSIQUE ---- */
function startPrepSeries(){
  if(!running) return;
  const pool = Array.from(state.prepExercisesSelected);
  if(pool.length===0) return;
  prepCurrentExercise = pool[Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length)];
  const dur = (+document.getElementById('prepSeriesDur').value)||40;
  prepSeriesEndAt = Date.now() + dur*1000;
  schedule(()=>{ if(running) startPrepSeries(); }, dur*1000);
}

/* ---- PAUSE / QUIT ---- */
function togglePause(){
  paused = !paused;
  document.getElementById('session').classList.toggle('paused', paused);
  document.getElementById('pauseBtn').textContent = paused ? 'Reprendre' : 'Pause';
  if(paused){
    pauseStartedAt = Date.now();
    cancelVoice();
    if(actx) actx.suspend();
  } else {
    pauseAccum += Date.now() - pauseStartedAt;
    if(actx) actx.resume();
  }
  if('mediaSession' in navigator) navigator.mediaSession.playbackState = paused ? 'paused' : 'playing';
}
function quitSession(){
  running = false;
  clearAllTimers();
  clearInterval(fatigueTicker);
  clearInterval(clockTicker);
  stopDrone();
  stopAllAmbiance();
  hideWeapon(); currentWeapon = null;
  blockReasons.clear(); blockLabel = '';
  shotBlockReasons.clear(); shotBlockLabel = ''; extractionActive = false; orderActive = false; heavyActive.clear(); heavyFreeAt = 0;
  cancelVoice();
  document.getElementById('session').classList.remove('live','paused');
  document.getElementById('sessWord').textContent = '';
  document.getElementById('sessExercise').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('session').style.backgroundColor = '#000';
}

renderWeaponCards();
</script>
